proof_body:
by
  intro F _ f
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro E L _ _ _ _ _ _
  exact ⟨(Polynomial.IsSplittingField.algEquiv E f).trans (Polynomial.IsSplittingField.algEquiv L f).symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (F : Type*) [Field F] (f : Polynomial F), Polynomial.IsSplittingField F (Polynomial.SplittingField f) f ∧ ∀ (E L : Type*) [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra F L] [Polynomial.IsSplittingField F E f] [Polynomial.IsSplittingField F L f], Nonempty (E ≃ₐ[F] L)
